# Twisted Oaks Studio

> Twisted Oaks Studio is an award-winning wedding and engagement photography studio in South Jersey, near Philadelphia, led by award-winning photographer Jay Cassario, who photographs every wedding himself. The studio photographs weddings in New Jersey, Pennsylvania and worldwide destinations in a documentary, editorial style.

Key facts:
- Owner and photographer: Jay Cassario (photographs every wedding personally)
- Jay Cassario is a professional photographer for Leica Camera USA and a film photographer
- Awards: Best Wedding Photography Studio 2023, Mid-Atlantic USA (Global Wedding Awards); Best of The Knot 2015-2026; Top 100 Wedding Photographers in the US and Canada
- Services: wedding photography, engagement photography, film photography (an add-on to any wedding collection or engagement session, alongside digital), albums and prints
- Pricing: wedding collections start at $5,200; every collection is custom tailored to the couple
- Travel: no travel fee within an hour's drive of Waterford Works, NJ; $200 travel fee for venues farther away; destination travel quoted by location
- Booking: most couples book 1 to 3 years in advance
- Favorite venues: Bishop Farmstead (Shamong, NJ), Johnson's Locust Hall Farm (Jobstown, NJ), Eagle Oaks Golf & Country Club (Farmingdale, NJ), The Woolverton Inn (Stockton, NJ), Cescaphe venues including the Ballroom at the Ben (Philadelphia, PA), Renault Winery (Egg Harbor City, NJ)
- Contact: jaycassario@gmail.com (replies within 24 hours)
